name: How can I stay on budget during a home renovation?

mainEntity.name: How can I stay on budget during a home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Staying on budget during a home renovation requires careful planning and discipline. Start with a realistic budget that includes a contingency fund, typically 10-20% of the total cost, for unforeseen issues. Make all material selections before construction begins to avoid delays and price changes. Communicate openly with your contractor about cost implications of any desired changes during the project. Avoid making significant changes once work has started, as these often lead to additional costs and delays. Regular budget reviews with your contractor can help keep things on track.
acceptedAnswer.description: To stay on budget, create a realistic budget with a 10-20% contingency, finalize material selections early, communicate openly with your contractor, and avoid late changes.
